semantics.MOVI: Rd = sign_extend(immediate); B must be zero
semantics.CHUNK: Rd[32*index +: 32] = W1, other bits unchanged; A=Rd, B=0, PAYLOAD=index 0..7, L=1; W1 is unsigned data, not an immediate extension
semantics.VADD: Each lane = (left lane + right lane) modulo 2^lane_width
semantics.VSUB: Each lane = (left lane - right lane) modulo 2^lane_width
semantics.VAND: Each lane = left lane AND right lane
semantics.VOR: Each lane = left lane OR right lane
semantics.VXOR: Each lane = left lane XOR right lane
semantics.VMUL: Each lane = low_lane_width(left lane * right lane)
semantics.VEQ: Each lane = all ones if equal, else zero
semantics.load: EA = checked_unsigned128(R[B][127:0] + signed byte offset); read width/8 bytes little-endian; replace R[A], sign extend iff signed else zero extend; no register update on any fault
semantics.store: EA = checked_unsigned128(R[B][127:0] + signed byte offset); write low width bits of R[A] little-endian; validate whole transaction before first side effect
semantics.BEQ: If full256 R[A] == R[B], PC = checked(PC + signed immediate*4), else sequential PC
semantics.BNE: If full256 R[A] != R[B], PC = checked(PC + signed immediate*4), else sequential PC
semantics.BLTU: If unsigned256 R[A] < R[B], PC = checked(PC + signed immediate*4), else sequential PC
semantics.BLTS: If signed256 R[A] < R[B], PC = checked(PC + signed immediate*4), else sequential PC
semantics.JAL: Base = PC if B=0, otherwise R[B][127:0]; checked target = base + signed immediate*4; R[A] = zero_extend(sequential PC); PC = target; unaligned target faults before link write
semantics.SVC: A=B=0; nonnegative immediate becomes TVAL; synchronous cause 11 trap to M
semantics.BRK: A=B=0; nonnegative immediate becomes TVAL; synchronous cause 12 trap to M
semantics.ERET: 32-bit, A=B=PAYLOAD=0; M with active trap only; PC=EPC; privilege=STATUS[2:1]; IE=STATUS[3]; clear STATUS[4:1]
semantics.WFI: 32-bit, A=B=PAYLOAD=0; S/M only; retire then wait for enabled interrupt
semantics.FENCE: 32-bit, A=B=PAYLOAD=0; all privileges; serialize preceding and succeeding data/device transactions
semantics.CSRR: 32-bit; A=destination, B=0, PAYLOAD=CSR index 0..8; M only; copy CSR to register
semantics.CSRW: 32-bit; A=0, B=source, PAYLOAD=CSR index 0..8; M only; validate reserved bits then write atomically
semantics.TLBI: 32-bit, A=B=PAYLOAD=0; S/M only; invalidate local ITLB, DTLB, L2 and walk cache; serialized
